title: Simple joy after releasing extra conditions

captions.physics: Removing conditions with a mistaken foundation
captions.energy: Waiting for readiness for another pleasure

meaning: Shared pleasure can appear after releasing an unnecessary condition when waiting for readiness leaves both free to try what is available.
text: Sometimes pleasure returns after abandoning what seemed compulsory. The Tower in the physical position of Svadhisthana describes dismantling a programme with an unsound foundation. The Hanged Man in energy leans towards complete readiness for another form. The Sun in emotions allows delight in living participation together. It needs no finally perfect plan. A small trial can please before the whole replacement leisure is defined or every change properly explained after the former programme breaks. What remains available may already offer enough for a real meeting.

Suppose you stop a complicated dessert recipe: checks consumed the evening and conversation scarcely happened. Ordinary berries already stand nearby. **Joy can return through simple participation instead of another large plan.** You can choose one filling, taste together and laugh over the failed first idea. Calling it a useful mistake is unnecessary. A free pleasant moment needs no complete new programme or identical readiness for every part.

The difficulty is replacing abandonment with endless preparation again. You seek a better recipe and miss available flavour. Waiting preserves the false condition that everything must be arranged before joy. Another perspective helps when permitting a modest beginning. Immediate pleasure need not compensate for earlier frustration to be real. It can simply appear through a concrete action both share, finally given time and freedom for a living response.
